title: Eruginous
summary: ERU'GINOUS, adjective [Latin aeruginosus, from aerugo, rust.] Partaking of the substance or nature of copper or the rust of copper; resembling rust.

inlines.v: ERU'GINOUS, adjective [Latin aeruginosus, from aerugo, rust.] Partaking of the substance or nature of copper or the rust of copper; resembling rust.
